name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
source:
"I'll teach you that you are my pawn."

He uses whatever is available to him. That is the kind of man Tokugawa Ieyasu is. He treats his vassals as pawns and never permitted anyone to read his heart. What was in his heart after such a way of life?

Temperament: Black-bellied
Likes: Strawberry daifuku
